android.reset: selectively remove firstLoadMarked, nativeCheckResp and hash_*; apply reset state and binaryChannel; preserve uuid/nativeConfig/bundleHashCache, breadcrumb and unknown installation KV; never clear store
android.binaryChange: queue existing cleanup; same selective removal as reset; apply binary state and binaryChannel; preserve installation KV
android.channelChange: same selective removal as binary change; apply reset state and binaryChannel; preserve installation KV
android.directories: _update; reset queues cleanup maxAgeDays=0; keep names resolved at execution, including launchVersion

harmony.reset: selectively remove firstLoadMarked, nativeCheckResp and enumerated hash_*; write reset state and binaryChannel in one flush; preserve uuid/nativeConfig/bundleHashCache, breadcrumb and unknown installation KV; never clear store
harmony.binaryChange: queue existing cleanup; same selective removal as reset; write binary state; missing or throwing getAllSync leaves hash_* orphans only
harmony.channelChange: same selective removal as binary change; force reset state and persist binaryChannel; preserve installation KV
harmony.directories: reset queues cleanup maxAgeDays=0 preserving launchVersion; regular cleanup age=3 days

apple.reset: reset state; selectively remove hash metadata, first-load/package-updated markers and check response cache; persist binaryChannel; preserve uuid/nativeConfig/bundle hash cache/incomplete breadcrumb and unrelated defaults
apple.binaryChange: same selective cleanup as reset except package-updated marker is set; apply SyncBinaryVersion state; preserve installation defaults and incomplete breadcrumb
apple.channelChange: same selective cleanup as binary change; clear current/last/rollback and set package-updated marker/binaryChannel; preserve installation defaults and incomplete breadcrumb
apple.directories: existing update root; preserve current process launch directory during reset; tvOS purge-restore unchanged
